骨骼构成身体的支架，保护器官，并给肌肉提供附着点。骨内组织还储存矿物质、制造血细: Bones form the supporting framework of the body, protect organs, and provide attachment points for muscles. Their internal tissue also stores minerals and produces blood cells.
骨骼肌通过牵拉附着点产生运动。它们与肌腱一起活动关节、维持姿势，并产热。: Skeletal muscles generate movement by pulling on their attachments. Together with tendons, they move joints, stabilize posture, and produce heat.
心脏是有四个腔的肌性泵。瓣膜引导血液单向流过肺循环和体循环。: The heart is a muscular pump with four chambers. Its valves direct blood forward through the pulmonary and systemic circuits.
这些结构参与视觉、听觉和平衡等特殊感觉，把刺激交给神经系统处理。: These structures contribute to special senses, including sight, hearing, and balance. Their specialized tissues detect stimuli and work with the nervous system to convey information.
动脉把血液从心脏送向组织；在肺循环里，则把血送向肺。: Arteries carry blood away from the heart to supply tissues or, in the pulmonary circuit, to the lungs.
静脉把血液送回心脏。浅、深两套网络收集组织回流；肺静脉把含氧血从肺带回。: Veins return blood toward the heart. Superficial and deep networks collect blood from the tissues; the pulmonary veins bring oxygenated blood back from the lungs.
脑、脊髓和周围神经传递并处理信号，支持感觉、运动、协调和自主调节。: The brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nerves carry and process signals. They support sensation, movement, coordination, and automatic regulation of body functions.
气道把空气送到肺，氧气和二氧化碳在此与血液交换。呼吸靠呼吸肌改变胸腔压力。: The airways conduct air to the lungs, where oxygen and carbon dioxide move between air and blood. Breathing depends on pressure changes produced by respiratory muscles.
消化道分解食物、吸收养分和水，并把残渣向前推进。附属器官提供胆汁和消化酶。: The digestive tract breaks down food, absorbs nutrients and water, and moves waste onward. Accessory organs contribute bile and digestive enzymes.
肾脏过滤血液，调节体液、电解质和酸碱平衡。尿液经输尿管到膀胱，再经尿道排出。: The kidneys filter blood and regulate fluid, electrolyte, and acid–base balance. Urine travels through the ureters to the bladder and exits through the urethra.
淋巴管把多余组织液送回循环。淋巴结等淋巴器官参与免疫监视。: Lymphatic vessels return excess tissue fluid to the circulation. Lymph nodes and other lymphoid organs support immune surveillance and responses.
内分泌器官把激素释放进血液，协调代谢、生长、应激和生殖。: Endocrine organs release hormones into the blood to coordinate processes such as metabolism, growth, stress responses, and reproduction.
这里呈现的是男性生殖结构，参与精子的生成、成熟、输送和性激素分泌。: The male reproductive structures represented here contribute to sperm production, maturation, transport, and the production of sex hormones.
体表提供外轮廓参照。皮肤构成屏障，并参与感觉和体温调节。: The body surface provides an outer anatomical reference. The integumentary system forms a protective barrier and contributes to sensation and temperature regulation.
软骨、韧带和其他结缔组织支撑、连接并分隔结构，稳定关节并分散载荷。: Cartilage, ligaments, and other connective tissues support, connect, and separate structures. Their roles include stabilizing joints and distributing mechanical loads.
胸腔里的肌性泵。右侧把血送进肺，左侧把血送进全身循环。: A muscular pump in the chest. Its right side sends blood to the lungs; its left side sends blood through the systemic circulation.
膈肌右侧下方的大器官。处理吸收来的养分，制造胆汁，并合成许多血浆蛋白。: A large organ beneath the right side of the diaphragm. It processes absorbed nutrients, produces bile, and synthesizes many proteins carried in the blood.
神经系统的中枢。不同区域分工处理感知、运动、记忆、语言和内脏调节。: The central organ of the nervous system. Its interconnected regions support perception, movement, memory, language, and the regulation of bodily functions.
食管与小肠之间的肌性囊。把食物与酸、酶混合后再送入十二指肠。: A muscular chamber between the esophagus and small intestine. It stores and mixes food with acid and enzymes before releasing it into the duodenum.
左上腹的淋巴器官。过滤血液、清除衰老血细胞，并参与免疫反应。: A lymphoid organ in the upper left abdomen. It filters blood, removes aging blood cells, and participates in immune responses.
同时有消化和内分泌功能。向小肠输送消化酶，并向血液释放胰岛素和胰高血糖素。: An abdominal organ with digestive and endocrine roles. It supplies enzymes to the small intestine and releases hormones including insulin and glucagon.
骨盆里的肌性储袋。肾脏形成的尿液经输尿管到达这里。: A muscular reservoir in the pelvis that stores urine arriving from the kidneys through the ureters.
连接喉与支气管的主气道。软骨环让它在呼吸时保持开放。: The main airway connecting the larynx to the bronchi. Its cartilage supports keep the airway open during breathing.
分隔胸腔和腹腔的阔肌。收缩时胸腔容积增大，空气被吸入肺。: A broad muscle separating the chest and abdomen. When it contracts, it increases chest volume and helps draw air into the lungs.
